lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno saw a little ice,
Tiny cube, that's kind of nice!
Kiki dove, look underneath,
A giant iceberg, big as a reef!
[chorus]
The tip of the iceberg, the tip of the iceberg,
There's so much more you haven't heard!
The tip of the iceberg, the tip of the iceberg,
Look below, it's bigger, my word!
[verse]
It means you only see a part,
A little bit, just the start,
Beneath it hides a lot, a lot,
Much bigger than the bit you've got!
[chorus]
The tip of the iceberg, the tip of the iceberg,
There's so much more you haven't heard!
The tip of the iceberg, the tip of the iceberg,
Dig a little deeper, take my word!
[outro]
So when you see a tiny peak,
Look deeper, there's more to seek!
